title: Site Preparation

stage.name: Site ready
stage.description: The ground is cleared, leveled and marked out.

questions.prompt: Why is a building site leveled and graded?
options: So the foundation sits evenly and water drains away from the house
questions.why: Water that pools against a house causes damage, so the ground is shaped to carry it away.

questions.prompt: Match each job to what it does.
pairs: Shapes the ground so water drains
Marks exactly where the house goes
questions.why: Clear it, shape it, mark it: then the foundation can go in.

questions.prompt: Testing the soil helps decide what kind of foundation a house needs.
questions.why: Soft, wet or shifting soil needs a different foundation than firm, dry ground.

questions.prompt: What does clearing space for a relationship look like?
options: Making room in your week for each other
Waiting until life is less busy
questions.why: Life rarely gets less busy. Making room is a choice.

talk: What would each of you need to clear from your week to make room for this?
